about_the_game:
Take the Driver’s Seat in Train World Driver!

All aboard for a casual and exciting train-driving experience! In Train World Driver, you’re the engineer, controlling locomotives from the golden age of steam to cutting-edge locomotives. Whether you’re delivering passengers across bustling cities or hauling freight through scenic landscapes, every journey is a new adventure.

Features

🚂 A Fleet of Locomotives
Drive dozens of trains, from iconic steam engines of the 19th century to today’s high-speed rail wonders.

📦 Missions Galore
Complete a variety of fun and challenging missions, from tight delivery schedules to scenic leisure routes.

🌍 Dynamic Mission Generator
Connect with Train World players! Train World players will be able to generate and share missions based on their rail networks using save files, creating endless gameplay possibilities.

🎮 Easy-to-Learn Controls
Designed for everyone, Train World Driver keeps it simple: manage speed, timing, and precision to succeed.

🗺️ Breathtaking Environments
Travel through diverse and immersive landscapes as you master the art of train driving.

Train World Driver is perfect for both train enthusiasts and casual gamers looking for a laid-back, engaging experience. Climb aboard and discover the joy of being a train driver today!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2320 or AMD Ryzen 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce GTX 960 or AMD Radeon R9 280 or better (2048MB VRAM or more, with Shader Model 5.0)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7300 or AMD Ryzen 1600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: nVidia GeForce GTX 1070 or AMD Radeon R9 390 or better (2048MB VRAM or more, with Shader Model 5.0)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers

short_description: Take the Driver’s Seat in Train World Driver! Control iconic locomotives from steam engines, diesel beasts, and modern high-speed marvels in this casual, fun game. Complete missions, deliver passengers or cargo and explore stunning environments.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Ukrainian, Japanese
